title: Commencement Ceremony
seo_title: Commencement Ceremony at Missouri Southern, Joplin MO
description: This is the 87th commencement ceremony at Missouri Southern State University, held to honor the accomplishments of fall 2026 graduates. It takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Leggett & Platt Athletic Center, 3950 Newman Rd in Joplin, Missouri.
